1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 1 bath(s), 2 dyes each; 0.2s pipe delay and 0.85s mixing response; two-lamp tolerance 5, 80mm spoil allowance per roll. Stock strength changes continuously during production.
1.natural_language: Click an anonymous LOT · SPOT TEST inlet to measure its dye under north-light and sodium. The revealed dye identity and two-light proof remain visible. Use the discovered inlet mapping to choose the valves for the pinned cloth. Adjust the dye valves until the wet cloth matches the pinned swatches under both north-light and sodium. Prepare freely before START ROLLS. During production, watch the dye-strength traces and correct for valve, pipe and mixing lag. Each roll must finish within its displayed spoil allowance. Maximize usable yield: every spoiled millimetre permanently reduces the quality score. CERTIFY ROLLS only after production finishes. Exceeding a roll's spoil allowance or a rejected committed certification ends the episode; later retries cannot pass. Preparation mismatches, valve adjustments, and spoiled cloth within the allowance remain recoverable. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
